preservedFrom.subject: er
preservedFrom.note: This archive preserves the exact old frontend book map. The original React source remains recoverable from the pinned Git commit; each page records its renderer and source data dependency.

migration.reason: The legacy pages contain React-only interactions, quizzes and simulation controls. A future importer must translate each renderer into editable Book Studio blocks and replace interactive components with supported block types.

sourceArchive.restore: Base64-decode this field and unpack the tar.gz archive. It contains the original React page source and all legacy page-data definitions listed in sourceFiles.
